logic.family_hypothesis: Monthly volatility-managed, long-only BTC/ETH cash sleeves may reduce exposure during high-volatility periods without trend forecasting. The test does not assume positive alpha.
logic.signal: At the initial OOS timestamp and then only on the first UTC day of each calendar month, estimate sample stdev of the last L fully closed daily log returns, ending at the previous UTC daily close. Compute realized annual volatility = daily stdev * sqrt(365). Set the sleeve target fraction to min(1, (target annual volatility / realized annual volatility)^2). No leverage; target fraction is measured against that sleeve’s own current NAV.
logic.sizing: Each 2,000 USDT configuration has an independent initial BTC sleeve of 1,000 USDT and ETH sleeve of 1,000 USDT (raw initial weights 0.5/0.5). Each sleeve holds BTC or ETH plus residual USDT. It cannot transfer funds, rebalance against the other sleeve, or earn cash yield. Monthly exposure changes trade only the difference needed to reach the target fraction.
logic.execution: Use only fully closed daily bars. Initial OOS signal is available at 2025-09-19T00:00:00Z and trades at the observed historical 1m open at 00:01 UTC. Subsequent decisions occur at the 1m open at 00:01 on each first UTC day of the month after its previous daily candle closes. Terminal positions are liquidated at 2026-09-14T00:01:00Z. These are archived historical backtest references, never current paper10 fills.
logic.costs: Each partial rebalance applies fee, estimated half-spread, slippage, square-root impact, exchange tick/lot/notional and percent-price filters; order participation is capped at 0.1% of lagged 20-day quote ADV. Cost assumptions scale by 1x/2x/3x. Below-minimum legal orders are skipped and recorded, not imputed.
